name: AI WhatsApp Appointment Booking + Reminder + Reception System

nodes.name: DB_Init_Manual_Trigger
nodes.notes: Execute once to initialize Postgres tables and schema.

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointments (
        appointment_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        customer_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
        phone VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        doctor_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        service VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
        start_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
        end_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
        status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED', 'RESCHEDULED', 'ARRIVED', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW')),
        calendar_event_id VARCHAR(255),
        created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
        updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
        reminder_3d_sent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        reminder_1d_sent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        reminder_4h_sent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        reminder_1h_sent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS doctor_unavailability (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        doctor_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        start_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
        end_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
        reason VARCHAR(255),
        created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
    );

    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_appointments_phone ON appointments(phone);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_appointments_status ON appointments(status);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_appointments_start_time ON appointments(start_time);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_doctor_unavailability_doc_time ON doctor_unavailability(doctor_id, start_time, end_time);

SELECT appointment_id, customer_name, phone, doctor_id, service, start_time, end_time, status, calendar_event_id, reminder_3d_sent, reminder_1d_sent, reminder_4h_sent, reminder_1h_sent, created_at, updated_at FROM appointments WHERE phone = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10;

parameters.query: UPDATE appointments SET status = 'CONFIRMED', calendar_event_id = $1, updated_at = NOW(), reminder_3d_sent = FALSE, reminder_1d_sent = FALSE, reminder_4h_sent = FALSE, reminder_1h_sent = FALSE WHERE appointment_id = $2 RETURNING appointment_id, customer_name, phone, doctor_id, service, start_time, end_time, status, calendar_event_id;

UPDATE appointments SET start_time = $1, end_time = $2, status = 'CONFIRMED', updated_at = NOW(), reminder_3d_sent = FALSE, reminder_1d_sent = FALSE, reminder_4h_sent = FALSE, reminder_1h_sent = FALSE WHERE appointment_id = $3 RETURNING *;

parameters.query: UPDATE appointments SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW(), reminder_3d_sent = TRUE, reminder_1d_sent = TRUE, reminder_4h_sent = TRUE, reminder_1h_sent = TRUE WHERE appointment_id = $1 RETURNING *;

nodes.name: Schedule_Trigger_15Min
nodes.notes: Automated scheduler running every 15 minutes to find upcoming appointments needing reminders

parameters.query: SELECT appointment_id, customer_name, phone, doctor_id, service, start_time, end_time, status, reminder_3d_sent, reminder_1d_sent, reminder_4h_sent, reminder_1h_sent, CASE WHEN start_time >= NOW() + INTERVAL '71 hours' AND start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '73 hours' AND reminder_3d_sent = FALSE THEN '3D' WHEN start_time >= NOW() + INTERVAL '23 hours' AND start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '25 hours' AND reminder_1d_sent = FALSE THEN '1D' WHEN start_time >= NOW() + INTERVAL '3 hours 45 minutes' AND start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours 15 minutes' AND reminder_4h_sent = FALSE THEN '4H' WHEN start_time >= NOW() + INTERVAL '45 minutes' AND start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour 15 minutes' AND reminder_1h_sent = FALSE THEN '1H' ELSE NULL END AS reminder_tier FROM appointments WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ((start_time >= NOW() + INTERVAL '71 hours' AND start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '73 hours' AND reminder_3d_sent = FALSE) OR (start_time >= NOW() + INTERVAL '23 hours' AND start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '25 hours' AND reminder_1d_sent = FALSE) OR (start_time >= NOW() + INTERVAL '3 hours 45 minutes' AND start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours 15 minutes' AND reminder_4h_sent = FALSE) OR (start_time >= NOW() + INTERVAL '45 minutes' AND start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour 15 minutes' AND reminder_1h_sent = FALSE));

UPDATE appointments SET reminder_3d_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '3D' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_3d_sent END, reminder_1d_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '1D' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_1d_sent END, reminder_4h_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '4H' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_4h_sent END, reminder_1h_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '1H' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_1h_sent END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE appointment_id = $2;
